jobs.occupation: Service Designer, Defence Service Development
jobs.description:
Design the services that keep Defence Forces mission-ready. As a Service Designer, you will shape and sharpen the service offerings that help Defence organisations turn complex C4I capabilities into sustained operational readiness.

The job

You will build on and further develop our existing service offerings across pre-sales, system design, deployment, training, testing and operations. Through service design, systems thinking and deep user understanding, you will strengthen how we package, deliver and support complex C4I capabilities – enabling customers to maintain and enhance their operational readiness.

Your key responsibilities:

• Building on existing service definitions and best practices by analysing customer organisations, operational contexts and delivery experiences to identify improvement opportunities

• Extending and refining the service catalogue by translating input from Sales, service delivery teams and customers into standardized service offerings.

• Improving service blueprints, delivery models and customer journeys with a focus on operational fit, role clarity and predictable outcomes

• Facilitating structured workshops with delivery teams and key stakeholders to align and validate service content

• Strengthening standardised service packages to ensure consistent, repeatable delivery across customers and constellations.

Success in this role means customers move smoothly from initial engagement to effective operational use, are fully prepared to operate our solutions, and sustain their operational capability over time. Your work directly enables Defence organisations to deploy and sustain critical C4I capabilities with confidence.

Joining the team

You'll join our Defence Service Development team in Aarhus, working to continually strengthen the services behind our customers' everyday-ready C4I capabilities. The team brings together service design, military domain knowledge, solution architecture, portfolio management and business analytics. You'll work with strategic projects where an operational mindset is needed, evolving service definitions and delivery models to keep them relevant and effective. You'll report to Marie Lunde Jørgensen, Manager Defence Service Development and collaborate closely with stakeholders across our departments worldwide.

Your qualifications

You hold a relevant master’s degree – ideally in Service System Design, Strategy, Technology-Based Business Development or a similar field – and bring:

• Preferably experience in service design or service development for complex digital solutions, including creating new services and maturing existing ones to support operational delivery

• Experience with refining service definitions and delivery models for complex technical and organisational environments, with a focus on clarity, consistency and reduced operational risk

• Sound knowledge of service design methodologies, such as user journey mapping, service blueprinting and pain-point analysis

• Strong English communication skills, spoken and written, with an independent and structured approach to complex challenges

• Willingness to travel 10-20 days a month

It would also be an advantage if you bring:

• Experience with large-scale enterprise or defence solutions and established delivery organisations

• Familiarity with agile, system-oriented ways of working, focused on continuous improvement and operational outcomes

• Experience with customer success disciplines, and an interest in helping shape our approach to customer success within defence

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks, from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Marie Lunde Jørgensen, Manager, Defence Service Development.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager, Anaesthesia & Patient Monitoring Solutions
jobs.description:
Ambu A/S is currently looking for a Project Manager to join our Patient Monitoring & Anaesthesia Solutions team in Global R&D.

Do you have experience in project management within the Medical Device industry and a strong technical background? Are you motivated by leading cross-functional teams and turning technical and business needs into successful product solutions?

As a Project Manager in our Patient Monitoring & Anaesthesia Solutions team within Global R&D, you will have the opportunity to lead a diverse portfolio of development projects, ranging from major new product development initiatives to focused projects that enhance, upgrade and extend the value of our successful existing products.

This variety is an important part of the role. You will be expected to adapt your project management approach to the scope and complexity of each project while maintaining a strong focus on quality, execution and business impact.

At our headquarters in Ballerup, where we develop many of our medical devices, we have a strong collaborative culture and a clear focus on bringing products to market based on a thorough understanding of customer needs. We develop, maintain products and production processes that combine multiple technologies in innovative ways. This requires strong project management capabilities, sound business and technical understanding, and broad experience with medical device development.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Leading medical device development projects of varying scope and complexity, from major new product development initiatives to product enhancements, upgrades and design changes, through to successful implementation at our production sites

• Establishing a motivating and collaborative working environment within global, cross-functional project teams

• Maintaining close collaboration with global stakeholders, particularly the Solution Steering Committee, to align resources, timelines, budgets and project strategies

• Setting clear project direction and ensuring effective planning and tracking of project progress, timelines and budgets

• Taking part in prototype builds, testing activities and interviews with users and stakeholders

• Contributing actively to the Solutions Team by sharing best practices, experiences and lessons learned across projects

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many different ways, and we recognise that the right candidate cannot be defined by a checklist alone. However, you are likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Hold a degree in engineering or a related technical field and have technical experience that enables you to support sound decision-making and address technical challenges throughout a project

• Have solid experience in Medical Device project management and bring a broad project management skill set and toolbox

• Are comfortable leading projects of different sizes and levels of complexity and can adapt your project management approach accordingly

• Have experience working with globally distributed project teams and suppliers

• Are curious, open-minded and possess strong interpersonal and collaboration skills

• Are committed and structured, with a strong sense of responsibility towards your work and your team

• Possess strong leadership skills and are able to create direction, engagement and momentum in cross-functional teams

• Have a certification in Project Management

• Are fluent in written and spoken English

**Apply

**Apply directly on our job portal, as we are not able to receive applications through e-mail.

The Talent Attraction team till engage with applicants on an ongoing basis, hence we encourage you to not hesitate, and apply today!

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

jobs.occupation: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
**Create Solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**

**Are you motivated by working with complex commercial contracts, legal risk management and major construction and infrastructure projects in an international environment? Do you enjoy combining strong legal expertise with a pragmatic, business-oriented approach to support decision-making and deliver practical solutions? And do you thrive in a collaborative role where you can build relationships across a global organization? Then COWI could be the right place for you.

**

To support our business in Denmark and internationally, we are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join our legal team at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby, Denmark. As an international consultancy, COWI delivers engineering, architecture, energy and environmental solutions across the globe. We contribute to some of the world's most significant and sustainable projects, and our legal team plays an important role in enabling our business, managing legal and commercial risks, and supporting successful project delivery.

In this role, you will report to the Head of Legal responsible for Business Line Denmark. You will join the Danish legal team, consisting of four senior legal counsels and two paralegals, and become part of COWI's Group Legal function. Group Legal comprises 25 team members based in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, the UK, Ireland and Canada, providing comprehensive legal support across COWI's business lines.

This position is ideal for an experienced legal professional who enjoys working hands-on with complex contractual matters, negotiating commercial agreements and supporting large construction and infrastructure projects. You will take ownership of legal matters, provide clear and commercially focused advice, and work closely with colleagues across the organization to manage risk and find practical solutions.

Your key responsibilities

• Providing day-to-day legal advice and assistance to senior management, operational management and project managers in Denmark and internationally.

• Structuring, drafting and negotiating consultancy agreements, framework agreements, joint venture agreements, memoranda of understanding, teaming agreements and other commercial contracts.

• Advising on contract management, claims management and the identification, assessment and mitigation of legal and commercial risks.

• Reviewing and negotiating contracts for large and complex construction and infrastructure projects, including agreements based on ABR 18, AB 18, FIDIC and bespoke contractual terms.

• Providing legal support to ongoing projects throughout their lifecycle, helping project teams navigate contractual obligations, risks and commercial challenges.

• Advising on disputes and settlement negotiations, including instructing and coordinating external legal counsel.

• Supporting, training and guiding line managers and senior management on legal matters, including contracts, public procurement, competition law, intellectual property rights and data protection.

• Supporting corporate housekeeping and advising on legal compliance matters.

• Providing legal support for mergers and acquisitions and other strategic business initiatives.

• Contributing to the continuous improvement and development of COWI's standard contract templates and legal processes.

**Your skills. Our teams. Together we design the future.

**

At COWI, collaboration is essential. We value professionals who build strong relationships, take ownership, and contribute with both technical expertise and a pragmatic, business-oriented mindset. You are proactive, curious and motivated to continuously improve how legal support is delivered across the organization.

On top of that, you will have:

• A Danish Master's degree in Law.

• Experience from a law firm and/or an in-house legal function.

• Extensive experience in contractual review and negotiation, including ABR 18, AB 18, FIDIC and bespoke forms of agreements.

• A strong understanding of legal and commercial risk management, with the ability to identify, assess and mitigate contractual risks.

• Strong drafting and communication skills in both Danish and English.

• Excellent analytical skills and the ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, concise and commercially relevant advice for legal and non-legal stakeholders.

• A pragmatic, business-oriented approach, balancing attention to detail with an understanding of the bigger picture.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership of complex legal matters and make sound, well-reasoned decisions.

• A collaborative mindset and an interest in working as part of a specialist legal team supporting a large international organization.

• Experience working in an international environment would be an advantage.

**A place to work and so much more.

**

At COWI, we collaborate with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow.

We support our customers' transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to set a positive standard by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the solutions we provide for our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun, because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we bring together expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and the environment to create lasting impact.

**Got More Questions?

**

If you have any questions about the role or what we have to offer, please contact Head of Legal Denmark, Kit Bækgaard at kich@cowi.com or Senior Global Talent Acquisition Specialist, Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you're interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

**

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths.

We take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting up teams and forums. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

jobs.occupation: Marine Administrative Assistant
jobs.description:
Join Bureau Veritas Denmark in an exciting position as full-time administrative assistant in the Marine Dept.

**Join an industry leader!

**At Bureau Veritas Denmark you will become part of an interesting and international marine environment, where independence is valued and opportunities for personal and professional development and growth are provided.

Your overall focus will be on administrative tasks in our Administrative Department and Customer Support Centre in Copenhagen.

About the job

In our Administrative Department you will be assisting with the end-to-end invoicing process for completed marine surveys and inspections, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional communication with customers, surveyors, and internal stakeholders. The role provides administrative support to Marine Management and Surveyors, handles incoming inquiries and requests, assists in resolving invoice disputes, and ensures the quality, traceability, and efficiency of administrative and planning-related processes.

In our Customer Support Center, you will ensure the smooth running of operations by handling the e-mail box (reviewing, dispatching, filing). Additionally, you will assist with handling requests for surveys and follow-up with stakeholders, including sending out reminders and collecting information. Tasks may also include invoicing, filing, maintaining, updating files and databases, and other data handling assignments.

You will work closely with internal stakeholders and ensure all tasks are dealt with in the stipulated format and timeframe.

**What will make you successful at Bureau Veritas?

**The successful candidate will be detail-oriented, customer-focused, and capable of achieving invoicing targets while maintaining effective communication across all levels of the organization.

We imagine that you have a strong background in quality management, combined with a keen analytical mindset and a customer-centric approach.

Here is a summary of some of the key qualities and skills you might possess:

• Quality Management: Understanding quality management principles, methodologies, and best practices. coupled with practical expertise in utilizing quality management systems to ensure compliance with standards, rules, and regulations.

• Analytical Flair: Analytical skills with a focus on invoicing data analysis.

• Solution-Oriented Thinking: Ability to think critically and develop concrete solutions to address challenges or improve processes.

• Proactive approach to problem-solving, seeking continuous improvement opportunities.

• Customer-Focus: Prioritizes customer satisfaction and understands the importance of meeting or exceeding customer expectations.

• Creating a harmonious approach that not only ensures legal compliance but also addresses the evolving needs and expectations of customers.

• Task Prioritization: Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.

• Communication Skills: Strong communication skills to convey information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are fluent in written and spoken English and Danish, or other Scandinavian languages.

Collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams and communicates project progress transparently.

You are a skilled Excel user and able to keep up with multiple IT-systems and continuous digital changes.

These qualities collectively contribute to a professional who can navigate the complexities of technical information, quality management and maintain an overview in a dynamic environment where the working day can be characterized by a hectic pace. You are committed to doing your job well and have a “can-do” attitude. It is important that you can work independently as well as in a team and hence have communication skills to navigate both settings.

Lastly, we are looking for someone who:

Holds a valid residence permit in the EU (for non-EU citizens) and lives or wants to live in or around Copenhagen

**Welcome to Bureau Veritas

**With one of the world's strongest brands behind you, you get the opportunity to make a difference in a global and sustainable company. Bureau Veritas Marine & Offshore is one of the world’s leading ship classification societies and offshore safety and verification bodies, pioneering the safety and performance of new technologies since 1828. With 2,650 maritime experts active in 140 countries, we operate as a global network, while meeting our clients’ needs locally through our regional marine operations, customer support, and technical centers. With a classed fleet of over 11,500 seagoing ships, Bureau Veritas is the largest classification society by the number of assets. Our client relationships are built on service, transparency, and trust.

**What we value at BV

**We serve as guardians of integrity, upholding the highest standards responsibly. We create trust between businesses and those they serve, demonstrating the ambition to work hard and the humility to learn and grow. We cultivate an open and inclusive environment wherever we operate. Ethics, safety, and financial control serve as the foundation for our shared culture. Being part of the Bureau Veritas family is more than just working, it’s being convinced that you will

leave your mark… in shaping a world of trust.

jobs.occupation: Business Intelligence Specialist
jobs.description:
At GomSpace, data is a critical enabler of everything we do, from developing advanced satellite solutions to running a global business serving customers around the world. We are looking for a hands-on Business Intelligence Specialist who can transform complex data into actionable insights and help build the foundation for data-driven decision-making across the organization.

In this role, you will play a key part in our digital transformation journey, enabling colleagues across Finance, Operations, Engineering, Commercial and Corporate functions to work smarter through trusted data, automation and modern analytics. If you thrive on solving complex challenges and want to influence how a leading space company leverages data to drive growth and innovation, we would love to hear from you.

Your Role

As Business Intelligence Specialist, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining GomSpace's integration and data platform landscape.

You will work closely with stakeholders across the organization to ensure reliable integrations, high-quality data, and scalable analytics capabilities that support business operations and decision-making.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Design, develop, and maintain the company's data integration architecture.

• Build and support integrations between systems such as IFS, Pipedrive, Jira, HR systems, QMS, ISMS, and other business applications.

• Establish and maintain a scalable data platform using Microsoft Fabric, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, APIs, and related technologies.

• Ensure data quality, consistency, governance, and traceability across all integrated systems.

• Monitor data flows and proactively solve data issues.

What Success Looks Like

In the initial phase, success means:

• Establish strong working relationships with key stakeholders across Finance, HR, Operations, Quality, Sales, and IT.

• Achieve positive stakeholder feedback (>80% satisfaction) on responsiveness, communication, and support.

• Become the trusted owner of GomSpace's integration and data-platform roadmap and governance model.

• Establish the foundation of the Microsoft Fabric data platform, including governance, architecture, and core data model.

• Successfully implement and stabilize integrations between key business systems (IFS, Pipedrive, Jira, HR, QMS, ISMS).

• Achieve >95% successful automated data transfer rate across integrated business-critical systems.

Over time, you will:

• Be recognized as the go-to expert for business data, integrations, and analytics across GomSpace.

• Drive a culture of data-driven decision making across departments.

• Successfully align and prioritize BI initiatives with business strategy and operational objectives.

• Reduce manual reporting and data handling effort by at least 50% through automation and standardized data pipelines.

• Ensure >99% availability of critical integrations and data services.

• Deliver a scalable enterprise data platform supporting all major business functions with governed, trusted, and traceable data.

What You Bring

You are an experienced Business Intelligence specialist with a strong understanding of integrations, data platforms, and enterprise applications. You are motivated by building scalable solutions that enable trusted data and better business decisions.

You likely:

• Have a bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.

• Bring relevant professional experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Data Platforms, or System Integrations may substitute for formal education.

• Several years of hands-on experience designing, developing and supporting enterprise data platforms, integrations and analytics solutions.

• Proven experience developing solutions in Microsoft Fabric and strong SQL programming skills for data transformation, modelling and reporting.

• Proven experience integrating business systems using APIs, middleware and cloud-based technologies.

• Strong understanding of data architecture, data modelling, governance and data quality principles.

• Experience building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and supporting business intelligence and analytics initiatives.

• Experience with ERP, CRM, HR and other business-critical enterprise systems.

• Relevant certifications in Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure or related technologies are an advantage.

• Fluent in English, spoken and written.

Who You Are

You are known for:

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to understand complex business processes, system landscapes, and data flows across multiple applications.

• Structured, proactive, and calm under pressure.

• Strong communicator with the ability to build trust across functions.

• Motivating person with a team-oriented mindset.

• Decisive and confident in complex technical and operational environments.

Here’s why you’ll love working with us:

At GomSpace, we’re on a mission to shape the future of space – one mission at a time. Here, you’ll be part of something bigger than just a project or a product. You’ll help build systems that connect people, enable science and expand humanity’s reach beyond Earth.

We believe the best results come when talented people are trusted, supported, and inspired to push boundaries together.

• Be part of a global company making a real impact in the space industry

• Get freedom under responsibility from day one – and grow with us

• Join a dynamic, full-service environment where no two days are alike

• Work across borders and build a strong international network

• Be part of a culture where collaboration beats competition – and milestones are celebrated together

Join our mission

You are welcome to send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis.

If you have any questions regarding the position, do not hesitate to contact Søren Lind Therkildsen, COO: sren@gomspace.com.

The primary workplace will be at our premises in Aalborg, Denmark. The position involves occasionally travel to suppliers, partners, and GomSpace locations

Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

As part of our recruitment process, employment requires you to complete a background check conducted by an authorised third-party provider in accordance with applicable legislation.

At GomSpace WE MAKE SPACE YOURS

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Atomistic Stabilization in Solid Oxide Electrolysis Cells - DTU Physics
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about using atomistic simulations and machine learning to accelerate the green transition? Do you want to understand, atom by atom, why electrolysers degrade, and design materials that make them last longer? Do you have a background in computational chemistry, physics, materials science or chemical engineering?

Then this PhD opportunity at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) might be the perfect fit for you. We are seeking a highly motivated PhD student for the project ATOMIZE: Atomistic Stabilization in Solid Oxide Electrolysis Cells, a collaboration between DTU Physics and Topsoe, funded by the Independent Research Fund Denmark (DFF).

Solid Oxide Electrolysis Cells (SOEC) are among the most efficient technologies for producing green hydrogen, but their long-term stability remains a key challenge for large-scale deployment. In this PhD project, you will use density functional theory and state-of-the-art machine-learning interatomic potentials to study SOEC electrode materials at the atomic scale and at length scales that were previously out of reach. The aim is to understand what governs electrode stability and how it can be improved. You will validate your simulations against advanced experimental characterization data.

In practice, you will be hired at DTU Physics and join the Computational Catalysis group led by Associate Professor Alexander Bagger. The group has a long-term goal to develop predictive models and schemes for new reactions and materials in close connection with experiments. The group is part of the Catalysis Theory Center (CatTheory), which provides a strong infrastructure and computational facilities, including the Niflheim supercomputer with GPU nodes at DTU Physics.

Responsibilities and qualifications
The successful candidate must have an MSc in physics, chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science or related areas, as well as a strong interest in atomistic modelling and machine learning for sustainable energy solutions. The candidate must display good communication skills in English, both written and spoken, be innovative and able to work both independently and in cross-disciplinary teams, as well as with international academic collaborators and industrial partners.

Successful candidates must document:

• Experience with atomistic simulations & density functional theory (e.g. GPAW, VASP, ASE)
• Python programming skills
• Preferably, experience with machine-learning interatomic potentials (e.g. MACE, NequIP, or similar)
• Preferably, knowledge of solid oxide cells, oxide materials, electrochemistry or catalysis
• Preferably, experience with high-performance computing and Linux environments
Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
You will be assessed against the responsibilities and qualifications stated above and the following general criteria:

• Atomistic modelling and DFT experience
• Python programming experience
• Machine learning experience
• Knowledge of materials science, electrochemistry or catalysis
• Communication skills
We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years. The starting date is from 1 February 2027 or according to mutual agreement.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Associate Professor Alexander Bagger (alexbag@dtu.dk).

You can read more about DTU Physics at https://physics.dtu.dk/.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 30 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter, max 1 page)
• Curriculum vitae (max 2 pages)
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.description:
The Department of Physics, Aarhus University, invites applications for a 2-year full-time postdoc position in the project “Probing nanoscale heterogeneity in ultrafast phase transitions”.

The position is available from 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The project
This project will use a recently developed soft X-ray imaging method to probe the dynamics of light-induced phase transitions at the nanoscale using X-ray Free Electron Lasers. The work will also combine lab-based experiments on time-resolved nonlinear optics.

Job responsibilities
The postdoc will be expected to:

• Lead XFEL and synchrotron experiments in soft X-ray imaging
• Prepare and characterise samples
• Lead experiments in nonlinear optics in the laboratory
Qualifications
Applicants must have:

• A PhD degree in Physics, Chemistry or a related field
• Experience with ultrafast lasers and/or X-rays and/or quantum materials
Place of work and area of employment 
The place of work is Ny Munkegade 120, 8000 Aarhus C, and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments.

Further information
For further information about the position, please contact: Simon Wall, simon.wall@phys.au.dk.

Application deadline
The application deadline is 16 December 2026.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self. 

Formalities and salary range
Natural Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

At the Faculty of Natural Science at Aarhus University, we strive to support our scientific staff in their career development. We focus on competency development and career clarification and want to make your opportunities transparent. On our website, you can find information on all types of scientific positions, as well as the entry criteria we use when assessing candidates. You can also read more about how we can assist you in your career planning and development.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.occupation: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Department of Psychology at University of Southern Denmark (SDU) is looking for applicants for a PhD fellowship within the field of philosophy
jobs.description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Department of Psychology at University of Southern Denmark (SDU) is looking for applicants for a PhD fellowship within the field of philosophy, with background in one or more of the following areas: philosophy of psychiatry, philosophy of emotion, phenomenology.
We are looking for a person with a relevant degree (M.A., MSc. etc.) in philosophy or a related field. Starting date is September 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is fully funded, full-time, for three years. The PhD degree will be awarded by the Faculty of Health Sciences.

 

Research environment

The PhD student will be based in the research group of Applied and Interdisciplinary Phenomenology in the Department of Psychology, SDU, at the Odense campus. The research group develops, disseminates, and applies methods to support cutting-edge research into subjectivity and the nature of human experience. Current group members have backgrounds in philosophy, psychology, anthropology, neuroscience, environmental studies, and pain research.

The group directly supports the professional development of its members, most of whom are postdocs or PhD students. In addition to receiving support from the project team, the PhD student will be supported by the broader group to develop their research, presentation, and teaching skills, as well as other academic skills, including those required for organizing academic activities such as workshops and conferences and for successful grant-writing. The PhD student will therefore be provided with the requisite knowledge and skills for pursuing an academic career in Europe or abroad.

The PhD student will also be provided with a work computer and a dedicated workspace at the Department of Psychology.

 

Project description

The PhD student will be part of the project, Understanding Experiences of Mood Disturbances in Depression (DEPMOOD), led by Anthony Vincent Fernandez. The project is funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark and runs for four years, starting September 1st, 2026. The PhD student will join the project for the final three years, collaborating with the PI, a psychology postdoc, and several external partners in Europe and the US, including philosophers, clinical psychologists, and psychiatrists.

The aim of the project is to establish a taxonomy of the variety of mood disturbances experienced by people diagnosed with depression, providing more precise characterizations of symptoms than those currently offered by concepts such as “depressed mood” or “anhedonia”. The project combines philosophical and qualitative methods, and includes in-depth interviews with people diagnosed with depression. The PhD student will not be expected to carry out interviews, as these will be conducted by the postdoc and external project partners. The PhD student’s primary role will be to help analyze the interview data using a combination of qualitative and philosophical methods. Their PhD thesis will therefore be a theoretical contribution, but will build upon the project’s empirical dataset.

In addition to producing a thesis, the PhD student will be required to take a variety of short PhD courses, carry out an international research stay, and fulfil light teaching duties.

The PhD student will be provided with DKK 10,000 per year for travel. Additional funds may be available.

 

Qualifications

Before the start date of September 1st, 2027, the applicant should have a master’s degree in philosophy or a related field and total course credits equivalent to 300 ECTS. Typically, this is a total of at least five years of education combined between bachelor’s and master’s degrees, with 60 ECTS obtained for every full year of study.

The candidate should have a background in philosophy of psychiatry, philosophy of emotion, and/or phenomenology. Familiarity with qualitative research methods (especially analysis methods) is an advantage, but by no means required.

The candidate should be proficient in English. Proficiency in Danish or another Scandinavian language may be an advantage, but is not required.

For further information about the project, please contact:
Anthony Vincent Fernandez

Department of Psychology

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: afernandez@health.sdu.dk

Please note that while we are happy to provide answers to questions about the position and application process, direct feedback on application materials cannot be provided.

Applications must include (in English, or with a certified English translation):

 

• 
A letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.

• 
Detailed CV, including personal contact information as well as any publications or presentations

• 
Certified copy of diploma and transcripts (Master’s degree in a relevant field). If the applicant is in the process of completing their master’s degree, they should provide transcripts along with a letter from their supervisor confirming expected completion of their degree before September 1st, 2027.

• 
Writing sample of maximum 10,000 words (e.g., publication, conference paper, selection from a master’s thesis). If the sample exceeds this length, please indicate which section should be read.

• 
A document listing 2-3 references, with contact information and a brief note about your relation to the reference. Note that reference letters will only be requested for candidates invited to interview.

 

At this stage, no project proposal is required. Candidates invited to interview will be asked to prepare a brief project plan.

Please do not use generative AI in the formulation of any application materials. The purpose of these materials is to gain a clear sense of you and your abilities.

Shortlisting and interviews may be used in the assessment process.
 

For purposes of evaluation and assessment, application materials may be shared with external members of the project team at Aarhus University and Amsterdam University Medical Center.

Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated

 

Closing date January 15th, 2027

 

We expect to conduct interviews within two months of the application closing date.
Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.
 

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.

Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98   per year.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.occupation: Demand Planner
jobs.description:
Are you structured, analytical, and motivated by ensuring that products are available when our customers need them?

We are looking for a Demand Planner to support the daily planning and replenishment of our warehouse assortment and help ensure the right balance between product availability and inventory.

In this role, you will work hands-on with demand forecasts, replenishment, purchase orders, inventory levels, and planning exceptions. You will be an important link between Sales, Procurement, Warehouse, Operations, and our suppliers and factories, helping turn demand into clear and executable supply requirements.

Your key responsibilities

• 
Maintain and update demand forecasts based on sales history, trends, customer input, and changes in demand.

• 
Plan replenishment and ensure timely ordering of products for our warehouse assortment.

• 
Follow up on open purchase orders, delivery dates, and expected incoming supply.

• 
Monitor stock levels and identify potential shortages, excess inventory, and availability risks.

• 
React to changes in demand and supply and adjust plans accordingly.

• 
Follow up on service level, forecast accuracy, inventory, and other operational planning KPIs.

• 
Work closely with Sales, Procurement, Warehouse, and Operations to resolve day-to-day planning and availability issues.

• 
Maintain high-quality planning parameters and master data.

• 
Support improvements to planning processes, systems, and ways of working.

Who are you?

You have experience within demand planning, replenishment, purchasing, inventory management, or supply chain planning and enjoy working in a role where you are close to the daily operation.

You are comfortable working with numbers, data, and planning systems and have a structured approach to managing priorities and following up on deviations. Experience with ERP systems, forecasting or replenishment tools, and Excel is an advantage.

As a person, you are structured, proactive, persistent, and solution-oriented. You take ownership of your area, follow issues through to resolution, and communicate clearly with colleagues and stakeholders.

What we offer

You will join an international planning organization and take responsibility for an important part of our daily planning operation. Your work will have a direct impact on product availability, inventory levels, and customer service.

You will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Procurement, Logistics, Warehouse, and Operations and have opportunities to develop your competencies within demand and supply chain planning.

The position is based in Tvis, Holstebro.

jobs.occupation: PhD fellowship/scholarship, Integrating Hormonal and Biomechanical Stimuli in Multi-scale Modelling of human Vascular cells
jobs.employer_name: Technical Sciences - Institut for Mekanik og Produ
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Mechanical and Production Engineering programme. The position is available from 01 March 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
Integrating Hormonal and Biomechanical Stimuli in Multi-scale Modelling of human Vascular cells

Research area and project description:
As part of the ERC Starting Grant project DISSEX, which aims at developing a sex-aware multiscale framework to predict vascular dissection risk, we are looking for a highly motivated PhD candidate to join our multi-disciplinary Cardiovascular Engineering (CareEng) group at Aarhus University. This PhD project specifically aims at quantifying how human coronary arteries respond to systemic hormonal fluctuations and biomechanical stress through both experimental and computational techniques. There are 2 objectives.

Objective 1: Experimental investigation of vascular adaptation
The candidate will use innovative microfluidic platforms and ex vivo human coronary arteries to recreate physiological and pathological vascular environments. By exposing vascular tissues to controlled flow, pressure, and hormone profiles representative of daily fluctuations in estradiol, cortisol, and testosterone, the project will quantify how endothelial and smooth muscle cells respond in terms of proliferation, apoptosis, signalling, and biomechanical function. Particular attention will be given to endothelial pathways involving nitric oxide and endothelin-1, providing a unique dataset on how systemic and mechanical stimuli jointly influence vascular health.

Objective 2: Development of a multiscale computational model
Building on the experimental findings, the candidate will develop a multiscale computational framework linking cellular activity to vessel-scale biomechanics. Combining agent-based modelling with computational fluid dynamics, the model will integrate hormonal regulation, cellular adaptation, and biomechanical stresses within the vascular wall. The resulting digital platform will enable mechanistic investigation of vascular remodelling processes and provide a foundation for understanding conditions that may predispose arteries to dissection.

The PhD candidate will join an interdisciplinary team bringing together expertise in vascular physiology, Cardiovascular biomechanics, microfluidics and fabrication; computational modelling, and clinical cardiovascular medicine. The project includes close collaboration with clinicians, biologists, and engineers and provides access to state-of-the-art laboratory and computational research facilities.

Qualifications and specific competences:
We are looking for highly motivated and independent candidates with the intention to complete a 3-year PhD at Aarhus University. The ideal candidate is expected to have most of the following qualifications:
 
• Master’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biomechanical Engineering, Biotechnology or relevant fields.
• In-depth knowledge in fluid mechanics and cardiovascular applications.
• Experience with cell culture and tissue engineering
• Familiarity with numerical modelling (CFD), and software such as COMSOL, SimVascular, or similar software
• (optional) Previous exposure to agent-based modelling or systems biology
• excellent written and spoken English (optional Danish).

Place of employment and place of work:
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Department of Mechanical and Production Engineering, Aarhus University, Katrinebjergvej 89F, 8200 Aarhus N.
Contacts:
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Mahdi Abkar, e-mail: abkar@mpe.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Monika Colombo, e-mail: mc@mpe.au.dk (co-supervisor)
For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk

Please follow this link to submit your application.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.
